title: Sensitive GPS location data received by backend
description: The backend receives live GPS coordinates from the child's device, which constitutes highly sensitive personal data (location tracking of a minor) that may exceed what is strictly necessary depending on the app's purpose.

title: Excessive frequency of location updates
description: Live GPS coordinates transmitted at regular intervals imply continuous or high-frequency collection and processing of personal data beyond minimal functional needs for many use cases.

title: Child data subject unaware of location sharing
description: As the source, the child (data subject) may lack awareness that their device is continuously transmitting precise location data to the backend.

title: Frequent writes of location pings
description: Backend writes each location ping, resulting in frequent processing of personal location data that may exceed functional needs for the Location History Store.

title: Extended retention of location history
description: Storing in a Location History Store implies personal data may be kept longer than strictly necessary for system functionality.

title: Identifiable location data stored
description: Location pings received and stored allow derivation of data subject identity through patterns or known locations.

title: Profiling via location history
description: Stored location pings enable analysis for patterns to profile and link data to an individual.

title: Location pings linked via unique identifier
description: The forwarded location pings likely contain a unique user or device identifier allowing linking of location data to a specific individual across flows or storage.
uncertainty_note: Flow description does not explicitly mention identifiers in the pings; this is inferred from typical location ping structure needed for per-user geofencing.

title: Sensitive location data received by engine
description: Geofencing engine receives highly sensitive location data which may be more sensitive than minimally required if zones could be checked with less granular or anonymized data.
uncertainty_note: Description states purpose is zone check but does not confirm if granularity or sensitivity exceeds functional minimum.

title: Linking via friend's house zone
description: Zone definitions include 'friend's house' which combines data linking the data subject to other individuals through known relations.

title: Revealing location attributes
description: Configured zones such as home, school and friend's house contain revealing attributes that support identification of the data subject or family.

title: Sensitive location data types
description: Geofencing engine receives and processes highly sensitive zone definitions (home, school, friend's house) which may exceed strict functional necessity in granularity or type.
uncertainty_note: Flow description implies necessity but sensitivity of location data warrants review.

title: Unawareness of zone data sharing
description: Data subjects may be unaware that their configured family zone definitions are read and processed by the Geofencing Engine.

title: Potential data minimization violation
description: Reading all configured zones (home, school, friend's house) may process more personal data than strictly necessary for geofencing functionality.
uncertainty_note: No explicit evidence of excess but family account context suggests possible over-sharing of zones.

title: Sensitive location data disclosure
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine shares arrival/departure notifications containing the child's location zone events, which constitute sensitive personal data.
assumptions: The notification includes details about the child's location or zone.

title: Child data subject unawareness
description: The child whose location triggers the notification may be unaware that their geofencing events are being processed and disclosed to the parent.

title: Identified information in notification metadata
description: The data flow may include metadata that identifies the child or the specific geofencing event.
assumptions: Metadata or notification headers contain identifiers.
uncertainty_note: Flow description does not explicitly detail metadata contents.

title: Exposure to parent as predetermined party
description: Personal location data is made accessible to the parent, which while intended may still pose disclosure risks if not properly scoped.

title: Processing of identified child profile data
description: The Mobile App Backend processes identified personal data including the child's name, date of birth, and school as part of account registration and profile creation.
assumptions: The system is designed to handle child profiles for geofencing/parental control functionality.

title: Child data subject unawareness of processing
description: The parent shares the child's personal data (name, DOB, school, geofence zones) to register and create a profile, but the child (data subject) is likely unaware of this data collection and processing.
assumptions: Child is a minor and not directly involved in the registration process.

title: Collection of sensitive child data types
description: The backend collects sensitive data types such as child's DOB, school, and geofence location zones, which may be more sensitive than strictly required depending on exact functionality.
assumptions: Geofencing implies location data processing which is inherently sensitive.
uncertainty_note: Exact necessity of school and DOB granularity not specified in flow.

title: Potential unlawful processing of child personal data
description: Processing of child's personal data via parent registration may involve issues with valid consent or lawful basis under regulations like GDPR for minors.
assumptions: Child data requires special protections and verifiable parental consent.
uncertainty_note: Specific consent mechanism not described in the flow.

title: Processing of identified child profile data
description: The Family Account & Permissions Store receives and stores child profile data which contains identified information.
uncertainty_note: Child profiles typically include names, IDs or other direct identifiers based on standard app design patterns.

title: Storage of sensitive child profile and geofence data
description: The datastore stores highly sensitive data types including child profiles and geofence (location) zones.

title: Risk of unlawful processing of children's personal data
description: Storing child profile data without explicit evidence of valid consent or other lawful basis raises non-compliance risks under regulations like GDPR.
uncertainty_note: No details provided on consent or legal basis for processing child data.

title: Processing of identified data for child location request
description: The request from the parent includes identifiers for authentication and to specify the child, which the Mobile App Backend processes to retrieve and display the location or history.

title: Linking through unique identifiers in transit
description: The data flow carries unique identifiers (e.g., child ID, parent session token) that can link the request to specific individuals.

title: Attributable request evidence
description: Logging the request at the backend creates a record attributing the action of viewing the child's location to the parent.

title: Detection via observed request communication
description: Observation of the request flow reveals that a parent is actively querying a child's location or history.

title: Child data subject unawareness of access request
description: The child whose location is being requested may remain unaware of the parent's request and the backend's processing of their location data.

title: Processing of identified location history
description: The backend retrieves and processes location history data which is identified or directly linked to the data subject to serve the map/history view.

title: Location history as attributable evidence
description: The retrieved location history data can be used as evidence to attribute past actions or presence to the data subject, preventing denial of claims about their whereabouts.

title: Dynamic set of secondary guardians accessing child's location
description: Processing the invitation at the backend enables child's location data to be accessed by a dynamically determined set of secondary guardians (e.g. grandparents or relatives) chosen by the parent, leading to personal data being shared with parties beyond the primary user in a way that may not be strictly scoped or limited.

title: Child unaware of location sharing with secondary guardians
description: The backend processes the invitation to share the child's location without mechanisms to ensure or inform the child (data subject) about who can now view their location data.

title: Parent unaware of privacy implications when inviting secondary guardian
description: The parent, as the user sharing personal data about the child, may not fully understand or be informed of the privacy consequences of granting location access to secondary guardians via the app backend.

title: Sharing of sensitive live location data
description: Backend shares child's live location (highly sensitive data type) with secondary guardian as part of granting access.

title: Exposure to predetermined external party
description: Child's live location is made accessible to the secondary guardian, a predetermined external entity.

title: Potential excessive retention by recipient
description: Secondary guardian receives and may retain child's live location longer than necessary.
uncertainty_note: No specific info on recipient's retention practices

title: Child unawareness of location sharing
description: The child (data subject) may be unaware that their live location is being shared with the secondary guardian by the backend.

title: Exposure of analytics to predetermined external partner
description: The backend shares aggregated usage and engagement analytics with a known advertising/analytics partner, exposing this data to an external party beyond the core app functionality.
assumptions: Even aggregated data may carry residual privacy risks when shared externally.
uncertainty_note: Aggregation level and exact data fields not specified in flow description.

title: User unawareness of analytics sharing
description: Data subjects may be unaware that their usage and engagement data is aggregated and shared with an advertising partner to support the free tier.
assumptions: No mention of consent or transparency mechanisms in the flow.

title: Group profiling from aggregated analytics
description: The advertising partner receives aggregated analytics which can be used to profile groups of individuals based on usage patterns and engagement.
assumptions: Aggregated data still enables insights about user groups that could be linked back.
uncertainty_note: Depends on granularity of aggregation not detailed in description.

title: Sensitive location data received by backend
description: The Mobile App Backend receives the child's current location as part of an SOS or check-in message, which constitutes highly sensitive personal data that may not be strictly necessary beyond the immediate forwarding to the parent.

title: Child unaware of data processing implications
description: The child sending the manual check-in/SOS with location may not be fully aware of how the backend will process, store, or further disclose this personal data.
uncertainty_note: Child is actively sending, so some awareness of initial disclosure exists, but downstream processing may not be clear.

title: Processing of identified child data
description: The backend processes the check-in/SOS message which originates from and identifies the specific child along with their location.
